api.notes: optional | required; provided to descendants as `optionality` on formLayoutContext.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host, `::part(base)` or the documented attributes.
The element itself is the handle; the box is reachable as part "base".

hooks.notes: @tecton-wc/core/context/keys.js (WP-F): {direction, optionality}. Provided by ContextProvider on the host; the nearest layout wins, so nesting overrides.

differences.text: The context value names the field `optionality` (upstream `defaultOptionality`) and is `undefined` for children outside a layout instead of upstream's `{direction: "vertical"}` default; consumers apply the vertical default themselves.

horizontal-labels collapses at a viewport width of 480px or less like upstream (a media query, not a container query); the fields inside render with display: contents so their label and control are the grid items (done by tct-field / the controls through formLayoutContext).

core.form-layout.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] grid and flex containers, gap; [mwg:web-components] context provider (Context Community Protocol, A-10); [mwg:shadow-dom] slot inside the container. Integration with tct-field / tct-text-input (label placement, aria-required) is tested with those elements.
